purpose: Consistent production SQLite backup immediately before deploying the additive M8 run-creation receipt table

backup.schema_hash_method: newline-joined non-null sqlite_master.sql ordered by type,name
backup.method: SQLite online backup API from a read-only source connection; temporary copy outside the serving volume, gzip stream over Railway SSH, decompressed and reverified locally; remote temporary file removed

rollback.ordinary_code_rollback: Redeploy the last verified code commit while retaining the additive receipt table and all current production data. Keep the current zero-cost model variables; do not restore paid settings.
rollback.data_recovery: Restore this snapshot only after a separately justified data-loss decision with the API stopped; it predates all writes after capture. Do not use database restoration for an ordinary code rollback.
rollback.model_eligibility: Before any new campaign inference, recheck current OpenRouter zero-price eligibility. The selected Nex Pro free offer was advertised to expire 2026-09-25; do not use a paid fallback.
